note: Locked voice choices for voice.mjs (video guideline §10): Yeasir's own ElevenLabs voice clone, the same clone and settings the ch repo uses. No secrets here: the API key comes from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (Windows: a user environment variable) or the macOS Keychain (service 'elevenlabs-api'). Change a setting only to fix a problem, never in the middle of a video. takes: one per scene; retries: extra takes only when a take fails the word check (a word missing, added or changed, or a clipped ending), never for taste. 'processing' is one loudness chain over the whole voice: pre, then a gain trimmed until the voice measures target_lufs, then post.
